programme.desc: Cornish king crab is on the menu for Rick as he heads out of Newquay to catch and cook this tasty crustacean. Afterwards, he takes a trip inland to Bodmin Moor to meet Robin Hanbury Tenison, one of the 20th century's last great explorers. His farm is home to one of Cornwall's most ambitious rewilding projects, where Robin's son, Merlin, has recently introduced a pair of wild beavers who are doing their best to restore biodiversity in this corner of Cornwall.

programme.title: E4 - Julien Fournie
programme.desc: To celebrate his fifteen years in haute couture, Julien Fournie has called on some sublime feminine archetypes. He discusses his work as he reveals his spring-summer 2024 collection.

programme.title: E6 - La Voix Humaine
programme.desc: The lyrical tragedy by Francis Poulenc and Jean Cocteau, created in 1959 in the form of a long monologue by telephone, ''La Voix Humaine'' (The Human Voice) is recounted with extracts from Mireille Delunsch's production in 2007, under the musical direction of Kwame Ryan.

programme.title: E7 - Merigot Sanzay (Paris)/Mathilde Granveau (Vietnam)
programme.desc: In Paris, Richard Orlinski meets Diane, a high-warp tapestry artist, who has taken the name Merigot Sanzay. The artist revisits this ancestral French craft by giving it a modern touch. Installed in a workshop-boutique, she creates abstract wall works inspired by photographs. The journey continues in Vietnam, in Da Nang, which inspires painter Mathilde Granveau. Her universe combines geometric abstractions and ethnic motifs from Vietnamese minorities, expressed through canvases or urban wall frescoes.

programme.title: E48
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.title: Truth or Dare : 6th Floor Rear Flat
programme.desc: Six twentysomethings from their own worlds converge at a bargain apartment affordable by one but perfect for six. With a goal to reach, a deal they make, and a year to complete, they 'fulfill' them with indulging pleasures and, endless games of truth or dare, and madness nourishing the 6th Floor Rear Flat. Sweet Dreams die well when the 12-month lease ends come an unwelcome reminder, the lost souls wake with frightening awareness to the touchline once they think never impossible. Between being responsible and getting away, is youth still a mighty weapon for failures?

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

From Riches To Rags
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

E2 - Underwater Learning Adventures!
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath & watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: E2 - Drawing, Painting, Music & A Quick Fix!
programme.desc: The Minibods are having a day of drawing, painting, music & a quick fix! Newt is drawing a beautiful flower but keeps rushing & crumpling her drawings, so she must learn to slow down. Then, when the Minibods help her finish a huge painting, Newt wants it all for herself! The creative chaos continues as Lulu struggles to make a music video with a marching Oddbird & Bubbles accidentally makes a mess while trying to fix a book dispenser.

programme.title: E7 - Messy Guest, Cracked, Hoppy & Teddy!
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend & a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer & has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, & when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health & Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: E6 - Magic, A Blob, A Show & A Bubble!
programme.desc: Join Bubbles for a day of magic, a blob, a show & a bubble! First, Bubbles is excited to watch Pogo's magic show, but her curiosity gets the better of her & she spoils his tricks! Then, she invents a brand new bouncy blob, but it bounces out of control & causes havoc all over the Bodpod! The adventures continue as Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show & tries her best to stop a giant, beautiful bubble from popping.

programme.title: E54
programme.desc: 無論過去、現在、未來，每個別具意義的相遇都造就華麗的日子，且無論什麼人都曾經擁有過華麗的日子。事業、愛情兩得意的能力者李志赫遇上責任感強陽光開朗的咖啡廳經理兼室內設計師池恩悟。兩人儘管外表看似光鮮亮麗，但在經歷人生的低潮後仍守在對方身邊，克服各種試驗，找到人生的真諦。

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: 擁有一頭白色頭髮、不老容貌，被譽為傳奇談判專家的尹洙諾，開始了一場高風險的併購談判，拯救一度拋棄過他的公司 HM 集團。擁有精英團隊的專業人士－包括頂尖律師、會計師、行銷專家和專利專家律師的尹洙諾，利用自己無與倫比的技能去講述企業間併購的故事。

programme.title: E12
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾。
